documentation.description: Allows to index multiple documents in a single request using the Arrow IPC streaming format. Rows are indexed through the columnar (batch) indexing path, which requires the index.batch_indexing setting.

index.description: Default index for items which don't provide one

wait_for_active_shards.description: Sets the number of shard copies that must be active before proceeding with the bulk operation. Defaults to 1, meaning the primary shard only. Set to `all` for all shard copies, otherwise set to any non-negative value less than or equal to the total number of copies for the shard (number of replicas + 1)

refresh.description: If `true` or `wait_for`, the indices that were written to are refreshed once, after the whole stream was indexed, so that the documents are visible to search when the response is received (`wait_for` doesn't wait for the next scheduled refresh: it would for each record batch). If `false` (the default), nothing is refreshed.

require_alias.description: If true, the request’s actions must target an index alias. Defaults to false.

require_data_stream.description: If true, the request's actions must target a data stream (existing or to-be-created). Default to false

op_type.description: Operation applied to every row: `create` (the default) or `index`

bulk_rows.description: The rows of the record batches of the stream are accumulated, for each target index, and sent as a bulk request when there are at least this many of them, or when the stream ends. A record batch is never split. Sending small record batches one by one is slow, as a bulk request waits for the translog of every shard it writes to to be synced. By default, there are 10000 rows for each copy of a shard of the target (primary or replica) that a node holds (the busiest node counts, and a `routing` parameter, that sends all the documents to a single shard, counts as one). An explicit value isn't multiplied.

bulk_bytes.description: The size of the Arrow buffers of the rows of a target that were accumulated and not sent yet, after which they are sent, and of all that waits, after which it is all sent. It bounds the memory used by a request, and can't be more than 64mb. By default, it is 8mb for each copy of a shard of the target that a node holds, as for `bulk_rows`, up to 64mb.

body.description: An Arrow IPC stream. Columns are document fields, except `_id` and `_index` that define the document id and target index.
